meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 访问外部服务时自动通过 OneCLI 网关发送请求，网关代为注入已保存的凭据，你无需提供密码或令牌。若服务未连接，Claude 会返回一个连接链接，并等你连完自动重试。
howto.when: 当你要 Claude 读取邮件、查看日历、访问 GitHub 等外部服务或调用任意 API 时触发；这是此类请求的必经入口。

say.text: 帮我读一下最近的5封邮件。
列出我的 GitHub 仓库。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude automatically sends requests to external services through the OneCLI gateway, which injects stored credentials for you—no passwords or tokens needed. If a service isn't connected, Claude presents a connect link and retries after you finish connecting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub, or interact with any external API. It's the required entry for such requests.

say_en.note: Claude requests Gmail API via the gateway with auto-injected credentials.
Claude directly calls GitHub API; no token needed.
Claude queries Stripe charges; gateway handles credentials.
